profil: PT Indosat Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications and digital technology services in Indonesia. It operates through three segments: Cellular; Multimedia, Internet & Data Communication; and Fixed Telecommunications. The company provides various mobile, wireless broadband, and fixed and digital telecommunications services. It also offers prepaid services, including Freedom Internet, Freedom 5G, Freedom U, Freedom Combo, Freedom Apps, Freedom Play, Nelpon Obrol Package, and eSIM; postpaid services; personal services comprising Tri Prepaid, Happy, Happy 5G, For You Pack, AlwaysOn, Nelpon Package; and international services. In addition, the company provides connectivity, voice, and mobile services; data center solutions, cloud-based IT infrastructure services, data analytics solutions, security service solutions, Internet of Things, Digital Apps, and Enterprise Private Network solutions; wholesale trade; employment and other business support services; and financial services. Further, it offers digital products, such as lifestyle hub, music platform, data monetization, digital touchpoint, and fiber-to-the home products. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Indosat Tbk operates as a subsidiary of Ooredoo Hutchison Asia Pte. Ltd.
